verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community user saying that a new model on Hugging Face or the Ollama registry is available after 'one ollama pull'. That suggests direct HF pulls work, but no first-party documentation describes the feature, its syntax, or which HF formats it supports. The other evidence covers the Ollama library, cloud models and integrations, not Hugging Face. Missing for 10: first-party docs on pulling or running models from Hugging Face, details on supported repo and quantization formats, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond a single passing comment.
